intro.en: Compare a personal message with a simple booking confirmation and find dates and conditions.

texto.en: Routine messages often make the purpose clear in the first line. Check names, dates, times and any action the reader must take. A confirmation may describe what is booked without explaining every cancellation condition; look for a separate policy if the text refers to one.

frases.es: Hola, Marta: ya tengo las entradas para el sábado 18. La función empieza a las siete y media. ¿Quedamos delante del teatro a las siete?
frases.en: Hi, Marta: I have the tickets for Saturday the 18th. The show starts at 7:30. Shall we meet in front of the theatre at seven?

frases.es: Si no puedes llegar a tiempo, mándame un mensaje y te espero dentro.
frases.en: If you cannot arrive on time, send me a message and I will wait for you inside.

frases.es: Estimada señora Vega: confirmamos la reserva de una habitación doble para dos noches, del 18 al 20 de julio.
frases.en: Dear Ms Vega: we confirm the booking of a double room for two nights, from 18 to 20 July.

frases.es: El desayuno está incluido. Su localizador es M4821. Para solicitar un cambio, responda a este correo antes del 10 de julio.
frases.en: Breakfast is included. Your booking reference is M4821. To request a change, reply to this email before 10 July.
